title: Cucumber Raita
description: A soothing and refreshing side dish made with yogurt, cucumber, and spices. This Indian-inspired raita is perfect for balancing spicy meals.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, garam masala, cumin powder, and cayenne pepper (if using).
Add the grated cucumber to the bowl and mix well.
Season the raita with salt to taste.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, garnish with chopped cilantro (if using).
Serve the cucumber raita chilled, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
